title: Certificate in No-Code Generative AI & Agent Workflows
summary: Create prompting workflows, knowledge assistants, no-code RAG solutions, and automated agent workflows.
capstone: No-code knowledge assistant and automated workflow for a department process.
prerequisites: Basic digital literacy; no coding required
delivery: Self-paced draft modules with proposed weekend workshops, peer discussion and office hours; no cohort scheduled.
outcomes: O1: Map decision boundaries and evidence requirements for a departmental request desk.
O2: Construct and explain a bounded prototype for a departmental request desk.
O3: Evaluate ordinary, ambiguous and adversarial cases against a baseline.
O4: Demonstrate privacy minimization, human approval and recoverable failure.
O5: Defend a no-code knowledge workflows portfolio with reproducible evidence and limitations.

capstonePackage.brief: No-code knowledge assistant and automated workflow for a department process.

milestones.name: Scope and baseline
milestones.deliverable: Boundary, data card, baseline and success criteria.

milestones.name: Prototype and controls
milestones.deliverable: Runnable or visual prototype, source log and approval path.

milestones.name: Evaluation and peer review
milestones.deliverable: Held-out cases, failures, peer critique and revisions.

milestones.name: Defense and handover
milestones.deliverable: Five-minute evidence demo, five-minute questions, runbook and limitations.

capstonePackage.exemplar: A fictional approval queue retains missing scores, routes uncertainty to review and never executes updates. Its evidence pack records input versions, thresholds, subgroup counts, failed cases and a rollback owner. Adapt this scaffold to the program brief. This is not a finished capstone solution.
capstonePackage.peerReview: A peer challenges an unsupported claim and repeats one test; the author documents the response.
capstonePackage.status: Draft brief; finished program-specific exemplars require SME authoring.

evaluationPlan.pre: Explain a bounded workflow before instruction and attempt the first practice pool.
evaluationPlan.post: Use unseen synthetic cases and compare outcome-aligned rubric scores.
evaluationPlan.analytics: Local practice attempts and module checkpoints, not official grades.

transferPolicy: No automatic credit. Map outcomes and assessed evidence; an educator approves equivalence and prevents duplicate credit. Dependencies #1–#14 remain TBC.
